name: 王可
objective:
本課程旨在提昇學生撰寫結構完整段落和短文之能力, 並著重如何重寫、摘要、 轉述、 陳述、筆記、編排、起草、修改等相關技巧。
This course is expected to expand students’ writing capacity and experience by helping them to formulate, organize, and present ideas clearly in well-formed paragraphs and compositions. Students will learn about rewriting, outlining, paraphrasing, synthesizing, documenting, note-taking, writing the draft and editing their own work.
scorePolicy: Students will be strongly discouraged from using generative AI as a shortcut for language production, critical thinking, and independent projects. AI should never become a substitute for your own voice or judgment. This course is a place to practice discovering ideas and making choices for yourself, which matters more than quickly generating smooth (and ultimately lifeless) English.
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources) 採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如 OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
